adapter.admonitions: A contiguous single-depth Markdown blockquote beginning [!NOTE], [!WARNING], [!IMPORTANT], [!TIP] or [!CAUTION] is prose; remove only the marker/quote prefix and retain its body in no-code arms. Nested quote depth >1 remains quoted-example material. Other blockquotes remain quote kind and are excluded by no-code controls.
adapter.azure: Mask INCLUDE references and directive identifiers/attributes; count include, zone/pivot, moniker, image, code, row and column markers. Retain all block content. Drop # [label](#tab/id) selector lines as navigation, count tabs, retain all tab bodies. Unknown directive lines are masked and explicitly diagnosed, not executed.
adapter.examples: Unchanged heading-word example/sample scope and ordinary quote/code exclusion; explicit publisher admonition prose remains prose even inside that structural scope.
adapter.fences: Recognize backtick/tilde fences after quote-prefix stripping, including indented fences; preserve code-as-data. Unclosed fence retains remainder as code and emits a diagnostic.
adapter.invalid: Strict UTF-8 and reserved-marker conflicts fail the corpus, not a subset. Unterminated opaque comment/template/include/tag masks the remainder, records exact diagnostic/line and retains the document denominator. Unclosed fences/conditional stacks/unknown constructs are explicitly reported.
adapter.liquid: Mask {% ... %} and {{ ... }} outside code, including multiline tokens, with hard boundaries; retain literal text in every conditional/platform/editor branch. Count conditional, reusable, variable, platform/editor, raw and unknown markers. Raw/endraw delimiters do not invoke a renderer: enclosed body remains source text subject to the same static rules.
adapter.liquid_prompt_examples: Explicit prompt/endprompt wrapper contents are publisher-marked examples, retained in baseline and excluded in no-code/example arms. Explicit admonition prose still follows the admonition rule. Inline open/close wrapper lines with body text are example kind.

resampling.bootstrap: Uniform N document rows sampled with replacement within each corpus/group; recompute top-decile share, zero-P share, both ratios and prose/all-kind densities. Raw unique-document counts are not the resampling denominator.
resampling.intervals: 2.5% and 97.5% nearest-rank endpoints among defined draws; record defined and undefined counts.
resampling.length_null: Exact multivariate hypergeometric marginals over per-document eligible statement slots, preserving observed total P and per-document slot capacities. Uniform distinct-slot allocation without replacement.
resampling.rng_revision: Existing NumPy 2.4.6 PCG64 Generator, SHA-256(seed|purpose|corpus|group|arm|segmentation|triggers) seed integer. Same sampling laws as legacy; not bit-identical legacy random.Random draws.
resampling.serial: 499 sequential draws in each frozen key. Overlap rules share P null and bootstrap document draws.
